definition: Selected body mass reference per taxon, used as a measure of body size: an external reference value, a cohort mean or an aggregate of study means.
coding: Continuous: ln(mass in g); one value per taxon.
sources: Wilman et al. (2014); Gerstner & Gerstein (2008); Cibis (2017); Szangolies (2017); Groth (2020)
uncertainty: References may not match the recorded individuals; dog value is the mean of two study means.

definition: Broad classification based on locomotor anatomy and habitual substrate use; describes specialization, not the frequency of single gaits.
uncertainty: Coarse 7/1/1 split; mainly separates hedgehog and raccoon.

definition: Broad relative proportions of trunk, limbs and neck in ordinary standing posture, independent of momentary movement.
coding: Nominal: robust quadruped, standard quadruped, tall long-necked quadruped, compact low-profile body.
uncertainty: Study-specific groups without measurement thresholds; raccoon assignment and dog breed variation uncertain.

definition: Length of the cervical vertebral column relative to the thoracic, lumbar and sacral regions; an anatomical proxy, not a measure of neck movement.
coding: Ordinal from r = C/(T + L + S): short (r < 0.30), intermediate (0.30–0.40), long (0.40–1.00), very long (≥ 1.00).
uncertainty: One or two specimens per taxon; hedgehog by expert judgement (intermediate as alternative); raccoon indirect; cattle near 0.30.

definition: Characteristic actions used to acquire and handle food at the taxon level; not feeding height or the share of observed foraging windows.
coding: Nominal: vegetation cropping, oral item acquisition, manual food handling.
uncertainty: Study-specific synthesis; species-typical actions may differ from the recorded feeding situations.
